parsed.public_message: White holds Central Heights. Neutrality and no first strike through t=450; one full public turn of notice before any later stance change. Self-defence is immediate. When the ring forces us off the crest we descend due south toward the centre, corridor x=520-660, from the north, and we will not enter the south lowland early. GPT's scout is 72 m east of us; please keep it off the slope.

private_messages.Claude: We will stay on the Central Heights crest as long as the ring allows. When we come down, it will be due south toward the centre, staying in the north, roughly x=520-660. We will not swing into the south lowland. If you keep your army south of the centre line, our routes stay clear. No stance change without a public turn of notice.
private_messages.GPT: Neutrality confirmed. Your camel at (730,830) is about 72 m from our eastern cavalry, across the slope. Please hold it east of x=760 in the lowland so we do not meet on the crest. We will not chase it. Our army stays on the heights.
private_messages.Gemini: Acknowledged. We stay on Central Heights. When the ring later forces a descent we come due south in the corridor x=520-660. West of x=480 stays your lane; we will not cross the West Plateau.

parsed.notes_to_self: T8 t=175. Truce LOCKED neutral to t=450, then 1 public turn notice. If attacked: enemy same turn, fight in place, no chase. HOLD crest: sarissa (568,812) 187m safe til ~t488; crete (545,855) 235m burns ~t439; volley (600,842) 206m ~t466; thessaly (508,832) 233m ~t440; odrysia (658,825) 186m ~t489; hero guards sarissa ~t475. Ring: 420@300, 220@450, 90@600. T17 t=400: move ONLY crete+thessaly ~30m toward centre, stay on ^ N of cliff z~780. Main descent ~t470 due S corridor x=520-660 to centre; told Claude we will not enter S lowland. GPT camel (730,830) 72m E across slope - watch, do not chase; asked them east of x=760. GPT main claimed (685,640). Gemini W plateau, ring ~t290. End focus: heroes, elephants, champions, ranged. Losses 0.
parsed.explanation: Grok holds the full army on the Central Heights crest, where the archers keep the high ground and every squad is still far inside the shrinking ring. The truce stays mutual neutrality: the nearby Ptolemaic camel is not chased. White names a later descent due south toward the centre so Carthage can keep the south lowland and the Seleucids can keep the west plateau.
